description.value: Per Se Social Corner is a Michelin-recommended Italian-Spanish fusion restaurant in Vancouver's Yaletown neighbourhood, celebrated for its blend of wood-fired pizzas, Spanish tapas, artisanal paellas, and a premium caviar program. It operates under the Per Se Hospitality Group and has a second location in Coal Harbour. The lively, high-energy atmosphere and daily happy hour make it a notable stop for cyclists looking to refuel in the heart of the city.
